method: Viewed all 17 existing qa-root-r001 rendered pages in five contact sheets for page geometry; additionally viewed pages 3, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 and 16 individually at their full native 786 x 1111 resolution for dense formulas, wide displays, diagrams, proof endings, footnotes and references. PyMuPDF text bounds were checked on every PDF page. No clipping or unreadable overlap was observed; page numbers, text, diagrams and references remain within the paper.
scope: Presentation and layout only; no mathematical review or certification. Source files and compiled PDF were not changed.
